title: EVALUATING AND IMPROVING CULTURAL AWARENESS OF REWARD MODELS FOR LLM ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating reward models using the Cultural Awareness Reward modeling Benchmark (CARB) via a Best-of-N sampling paradigm, where models must select culturally appropriate responses over mismatched ones across 10 distinct cultures and 4 domains. The study also perturbs core cultural concepts to test model robustness against spurious correlations.

Measuring the cross-lingual consistency of reward models by translating responses into different languages and calculating score discrepancies to determine if models inappropriately alter their preference scores based on the linguistic form rather than the substantive cultural content.
